description: Family Rossi (Marco, Giulia and our two children). On the way to Milan Centrale on 3 March 2025 our taxi was hit by a van; Giulia and I were taken to the emergency room and the four of us missed the train to Zurich. Accident report from the police and booking attached. Only the two of us were injured; the children were fine.

decision.explanation: We have referred your claim for review because we cannot yet confirm that the 3 March 2025 incident occurred within the policy period or that the claim was submitted within 30 days of the policy ending. The accident-report.md and booking-confirmation.md show that your taxi was hit and that the family missed the train to Zurich, so the missed-departure element is otherwise eligible. However, the documents do not state that the trip was cancelled or rescheduled for a covered reason, nor do they state that any personal belongings were lost, stolen, or damaged. Please provide the policy period and policy end date, and any medical report or other evidence needed to establish a covered cancellation/rescheduling reason or loss/damage to personal effects.
